replayFlow.definition: 团队球权区间可能包含短暂松球记忆；个人控制区间按真实控制者记录，结束原因为出球、射门、脱控或被夺球；球人/防守者距离按5Hz回放最近帧估算。传球方向按出球点与目标点；防线间距为防守方DEF与MID组平均纵向差。均为诊断指标，不等同官方统计定义。

physical.scope: EURO 2024 men; regulation 90-minute portions; goalkeepers excluded; positional starters >70min. Elite anchor, not lower-league percentiles.

technical.scope: England–USA, 2022-11-25, includes added time; illustrative single match, not a population range. FIFA and game pass/turnover definitions differ.

goals.scope: EURO 2024, 117 goals / 51 matches; includes extra-time goals. Context only, not a per-90 target.

europeanLeagueStats.scope: Available regular-league match rows in 21 European competition codes, 2022-23 through 2024-25. Availability and statistical completeness vary by competition and metric; no odds fields are read.

source.title: Soccer match event dataset
source.attribution: Wyscout event data; Pappalardo et al. (2019), CC BY 4.0.

method.variance: Unbiased sample variance using n−1; teamMatch uses one team per match, matchTotal uses one row per match.
method.definitions: Passes count Pass events; completed passes carry tag 1801. Shots on target are Shot events tagged 1801 or goal tag 101. Fouls, corners, saves and cards follow Wyscout event/type tags. Ground duels are reported as duels, not re-labelled as official tackles or take-ons. Scores use the regulation score field; event counts include only 1H/2H. This source has no tracking distance or xG.
method.limitations: Coverage is 2017/18 full Big Five first divisions, UEFA EURO 2016 and FIFA World Cup 2018; it is not a full European league/cup census and does not include a full Champions League season.

openEuropeanGoalStats.attribution: Openfootball / football.db maintainers; generated data is dedicated to CC0 1.0 public domain.
openEuropeanGoalStats.use: Broad European goal-score context only. Keep each competition separate. Never infer shots, passes, player roles, duels or tempo from goal-only rows.

method.seasonSelection: Openfootball Europe files labelled 2024-25 or calendar 2024, plus UEFA 2024-25 Champions/Europa/Conference League main stages and qualifiers.
method.scoreField: Use generated JSON score.ft as full-time/after-extra-time total; exclude score.p shootout kicks; include score.et match scores where supplied.
method.variance: Unbiased sample variance using n−1 across the listed match rows, and across home+away team-match rows.
method.eligibleCoverage: For broad contextual summaries only, include domestic rows whose scored matches / declared matches coverage is at least 95%; all rows and coverage are kept for transparency.
limitations: This pinned repository snapshot does not include every league, division or domestic cup in all UEFA associations; per-file coverage exposes gaps and is not described as a complete census.
Many files are score-only. Goals do not validate shots, passes, possession, duels, running distance or the match decision process.
The 2024–25 season is used for cross-league context, while calendar-year 2024 is used where the source schedules a European league by calendar year. These are not a single season boundary.
UEFA qualifiers, UEFA main competitions, domestic leagues and domestic cups remain distinct distributions. Cup ties are each a match; shootout kicks are not goals.
